title: fr.camera.sd_fetch arguments
description: Streams recording `recording`'s frames to the hub as an mjpg1 stream (flags b0 set), from frame `from_frame`; ends done after the last. BUSY while a stream runs; NOT_FOUND for a recording not on the card; UNSUPPORTED without a card.

stream_id.description: issued by the hub; the POST path names it

recording.description: the recording's id (its stream_id when made)
